decisions.reason: The original Definition falsely makes the geometric push-off independent of choices. In one injective tubular chart, graphs of epsilon_0*s and epsilon_1*s for distinct positive radii are distinct (indeed disjoint) because s is nowhere zero. The cited lemma proves independence of their linking integer, not equality of the curves. Replaced exactly that sentence, preserving framing classes, relative winding, AC_omega, orientation, and supplied-surface scope.
